scope: Every 16-bit ID across three callback/free length classes; nonzero high ID/length words, exact physical table indexing, callback arguments, cached payload/length after callback mutation and unconditional ownership release
limitations: Callback tables are broad overlapping RAM fixtures and callbacks/free are intercepted; complete stock callback configuration and actual handlers remain gates.
Lookup ranges can access words outside known table prefixes; no unsupported bounds guards or fabricated array extent are added.
Invalid record pointers and physical execution are not exercised; original instruction identity and whole-image source completeness remain open.
